document.title: Document management — Portable document format — Part 1: PDF 1.7

audit.method: Independent source-outline/table inventory cross-check and inspection of handwritten core implementations, source metadata, tests and independent validators. Physical PDF page numbers are retained. Family assessments do not certify every sentence in a chapter.
audit.sourcePreservation: The original source PDF bytes are retained. This file is an implementation evidence inventory, not a conformance certification.
audit.noCoveragePercentage: No aggregate percentage is given: definitions, writer behavior, conditional constraints, consumer algorithms and external standards have different denominators.

dimensions.inventory: Whether a source clause/table/token has a traceable entry.
dimensions.schema: Whether a named dictionary/entry definition checks known object types and unconditional requirements.
dimensions.writing: Whether executable core objects perform the PDF-native transformation/layout/state behavior, not merely generic serialization.
dimensions.semantics: Whether cross-entry, inherited, conditional, numeric, geometry and graph rules are enforced.
dimensions.validation: Unit cases and independent generated-file evidence for the declared subset.
dimensions.consumerAndExternal: Reader/rendering/playback/certificate/codec behavior and referenced standards are separate scope boundaries, never counted as implemented because a dictionary exists.

summary.reason: Complete table/token inventories coexist with incomplete writer algorithms and dictionary/graph semantics. Independent validators cover declared subsets only.

mechanisms.title: Conformance is a document and behavior contract
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: There is no complete conformance validator. Object typing and successful qpdf parsing do not establish every writer requirement or reader behavior.
remainingWork: Add per-feature conformance/version checks with explicit writer/reader scope, rather than a global implemented flag.

mechanisms.title: PDF version designations and feature availability
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Header versions are objects and xref/object-stream minimum versions have explicit checks; every dictionary entry and feature is not checked against its PDF introduction version.
remainingWork: An object-level feature/version requirement model and a document version audit.

mechanisms.title: Byte syntax, whitespace and delimiters
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Byte values and lexical delimiters are explicit objects; names and strings escape bytes before serialization.

mechanisms.title: Eight PDF value families, references and indirect identity
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Finite numbers, byte-preserving string/name escaping, duplicate dictionary keys, direct cycles, indirect targets and stream directness are checked. A generic dictionary intentionally accepts unknown extension entries.
remainingWork: Uniform graph semantic audits for feature-specific combinations and indirect/direct source rules.

mechanisms.title: Stream filter order and encoded versus decoded data
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Filter chains encode in the reverse of decode order and calculate encoded stream Length. Already encoded bytes remain explicit; passthrough does not validate their codec content.
remainingWork: Explicit external-stream/file data objects and all filter-specific semantic constraints.

mechanisms.title: ASCIIHex stream encoding
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Encoded bytes use PDF hex syntax.

mechanisms.title: ASCII85 stream encoding
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Partial groups, zero shorthand and end marker are implemented and tested.

mechanisms.title: Zlib-framed Flate stream encoding
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Flate encoding exists; it does not itself supply TIFF or PNG predictor transforms.
remainingWork: Compose explicit predictor transforms and matching DecodeParms with Flate and LZW.

mechanisms.title: PDF LZW bit packing, clear codes and EarlyChange
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Filter name and parameter dictionary exist, but no core LZW encoder is present at the audited release.
remainingWork: Implement LZW code-size transitions, table reset and EarlyChange with independent decode vectors.

mechanisms.title: TIFF and PNG predictor transforms
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: DecodeParms tables exist; core writer does not create predictor-encoded scanlines for all PDF depths and component layouts.
remainingWork: Implement bounded sample/row packing, TIFF predictor 2 and PNG predictors 10–15 at PDF sample depths.

mechanisms.title: RunLength stream encoding
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Packet boundaries and end marker are tested.

mechanisms.title: CCITT fax filter declaration and external codec boundary
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Parameter schema can be serialized, but codec bytes are caller-declared. CCITT T.4/T.6 are separate normative standards.
remainingWork: Typed validated PDF CCITT parameter object and explicit external encoded bitstream contract.

mechanisms.title: JBIG2 filter, globals and external codec boundary
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Named filter and globals parameter schema exist. JBIG2 segment encoding/decoding belongs to ISO/IEC 14492, not the two retained PDF sources.
remainingWork: Typed globals/encoded bitstream dependencies and PDF container constraints.

mechanisms.title: DCT JPEG PDF filter parameters
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: DCTImage preserves encoded bytes with explicit component count/ColorTransform/CMYK Decode. External JPEG parsing is in the optional image module.
remainingWork: PDF parameter/object coverage beyond the explicit grayscale/RGB/CMYK subset; codec algorithms require the JPEG standard.

mechanisms.title: JPX JPEG2000 PDF filter constraints
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: The filter name exists, but no specialized JPX image object validates PDF restrictions and derived ColourSpace/BitsPerComponent semantics.
remainingWork: Typed JPX PDF image and parameter constraints with explicit caller-provided encoded data.

mechanisms.title: Crypt filter selection and stream overrides
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: The historical R5 writer rejects explicit Crypt stream filters. It does not implement Identity overrides or the general ISO crypt-filter dispatch.
remainingWork: Explicit named crypt-filter object composition, Identity overrides and embedded-file-only encryption selection.

mechanisms.title: Headers, indirect object bodies and classic trailers
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: File writing has object identity registration, actual byte offsets, required Root and explicit IDs. It does not implement every optional writer feature.

mechanisms.title: Cross-reference free lists, deletion and number reuse
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Initial gaps become free entries and limits bound allocation. Incremental deletion/reuse and generation evolution are not writer operations.
remainingWork: Explicit deleted-object/reused-object operations and generation/free-list rules across revisions.

mechanisms.title: Append-only incremental revisions
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Generated snapshots preserve old bytes, identity aliases, trailer values and Prev. No external import, encrypted updates, signed updates or deleting/reusing objects.
remainingWork: Encrypted and signed incremental serialization; deletion/reuse; explicit hybrid conversion rules.

mechanisms.title: Object stream containers and compressed member records
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Header offsets, First, member identity, generation zero, excluded streams and conflicting member numbers are checked.

mechanisms.title: Cross-reference stream packing
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Sparse ordered Index, big-endian W records and managed Size/trailer entries are implemented. Crypt filter is prohibited.

mechanisms.title: Hybrid cross-reference files

clauses.title: Compatibility with Applications That Do Not Support Compressed Reference Streams

mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: XRefStm is representable as a generic trailer entry, but there is no hybrid writer layout or imported hybrid reader support.
remainingWork: Explicit hybrid cross-reference composition and incremental replacement/reference resolution rules.

mechanisms.title: ISO security dictionary and per-object encryption
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Historical key derivation exists, and Adobe R5 encryption exists separately. ISO per-object RC4/AES128 key handling is not integrated in the writer at the audited release.
remainingWork: ISO Algorithms 1–7 and R2/R3/R4 standard security handlers with independent encrypted-file interoperability.

mechanisms.title: Standard passwords, owner/user entries and permissions R2–R4
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Algorithm 2 MD5 key derivation is independently checked against qpdf R2/R3/R4 keys. Owner O creation, U creation and RC4/AES128 authentication/serialization are missing.
remainingWork: Algorithms 3–7, typed permissions for R2–R4, 40/128-bit RC4 and AESV2 object key + IV handling.

mechanisms.title: Public-key CMS recipients and key derivation
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Supplement SHA256 recipient digest accepts opaque CMS bytes. ISO SHA1 derivation, CMS envelope creation/verification and public-key writer are absent.
remainingWork: ISO SHA1 key derivation and recipient permission inputs; injected external CMS envelope backend; full s3/s4/s5 public-key writer selection.

mechanisms.title: Named crypt filters, authentication events and defaults
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Named dictionary definitions preserve descriptions; the R5 facade supports one fixed standard AESV3 policy and refuses unsupported overrides.
remainingWork: Typed encryption/crypt-filter configuration and general filter resolution with string/stream/embedded-file selection.

mechanisms.title: Catalogue graph and names
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Catalogue and known names/resource target families are checked. It does not yet validate every optional subgraph by semantics.
remainingWork: Optional graph validation contracts for forms, structure, navigation, metadata and all catalogue features.

mechanisms.title: Page identities, parent links, counts and inherited values
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Page ownership, ancestor cycles, count, direct parent and inherited MediaBox/Resources are checked. Page-size boxes and most optional page entries remain general values.
remainingWork: Inherited CropBox/Rotate semantics in the writer and all page-boundary containment/interactions.

mechanisms.title: Typed content operators, nesting and scope validation
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: All 73 tokens are inventoried and typed operators serialize instructions. Nesting and path/text/Type3 restrictions are checked; resource resolution and colour component counts are external to ContentStreams.
remainingWork: Explicit resource-aware content validation for fonts, XObjects, properties, graphics state and colour components.

mechanisms.title: Common scalar structures and explicit text encodings
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Text strings encode UTF16BE/ASCII, date objects preserve timezone, rectangles contain four numbers. Explicit full PDFDocEncoding codec and all string-type distinctions are not modeled.
remainingWork: PDFDocEncoding bidirectional byte/text map; distinct ASCII, byte and text string constraints; rectangle normalization where source requires it.

mechanisms.title: Ordered balanced name and number tree construction
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Keys order by bytes/numeric value, duplicate keys and child overlapping ranges fail, Limits derive from children.

mechanisms.title: PDF function types 0, 2, 3 and 4
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: All four function object families serialize; sample bits pack MSB-first, domains/ranges/arity/bounds are checked, calculator procedures are typed. Evaluation is a consumer behavior.
remainingWork: Independent PDF fixtures for each function type and stronger calculator input/output stack validation if writer semantics require it.

mechanisms.title: File specifications, embedded streams and relationships
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Named FileSpec/EmbeddedFile dictionaries exist; no specialized filename/platform relationship/checksum/collection embedding graph API is present.
remainingWork: Explicit embedded-file stream/filespec/dependency objects; UF/F platform relationships, AF-like later features only with matching specification.

mechanisms.title: Direct developer-extension declarations
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Prefix is explicit, extension dictionary is wholly direct and required BaseVersion/ExtensionLevel entries cannot be bypassed through generic updates.

mechanisms.title: Graphics object and operator syntax
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Operator scope checks are executed, but no PDF rendering/interpreter state machine exists.

mechanisms.title: Coordinate system and matrix values
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Six matrix coefficients and cm/Tm instruction serialization exist. Matrix operations/inverse and default user-space semantics are not dedicated objects.
remainingWork: Object matrix composition/inverse/point mapping where useful for source formulas; remove the remaining static identity factory.

mechanisms.title: Line styles, rendering intents and external graphics state
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Line cap/join/dash, numeric operand limits and q/Q balance are checked; most ExtGState cross-entry rules and reference dependencies are schemas only.
remainingWork: Typed ExtGState semantically coupled fields (soft mask, overprint, transfer, halftone, alpha and blend mode).

mechanisms.title: Paths, Bézier operators, fill/stroke/clipping
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Construction/painting/clipping tokens and instruction order are checked. Geometry fill/stroke rasterization belongs to a consumer.

mechanisms.title: DeviceGray, DeviceRGB and DeviceCMYK
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Device image component counts and standard colour operators exist; device-space object families and resource-aware component validation are not generalized.
remainingWork: PDF colour-space values separate from the device-image helper enum, supporting all colour consumers.

mechanisms.title: CalGray, CalRGB, Lab and ICCBased
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Parameter dictionaries are named schemas. No dedicated colour-space array objects enforce WhitePoint/BlackPoint/Gamma/Matrix/Range/N/Alternate constraints.
remainingWork: Typed calibrated/ICC space objects and embedded profile stream with source numeric/shape constraints. ICC profile parsing stays external.

mechanisms.title: Pattern, Indexed, Separation and DeviceN/NChannel
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Generic arrays can express spaces, but lookup sizes, alternate/tint-transform arity, names and Process/Colorants relationships are not checked.
remainingWork: Special space arrays as dedicated objects; validated palette lookup and tint function inputs/outputs; DeviceN attributes and NChannel composition.

mechanisms.title: Overprint mode and colour operand semantics
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Typed tokens serialize; active-space component counts and special-space overprint restrictions are not checked.
remainingWork: Explicit colour state resource resolution and conditional operand validation.

mechanisms.title: Coloured and uncoloured tiling patterns
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Dictionary schema and content streams exist but no specialized pattern stream binds PaintType/TilingType/BBox/XStep/YStep/Resources or checks uncoloured content.
remainingWork: Typed pattern stream and required nonzero step/colour restrictions with independent rendered examples.

mechanisms.title: Shading patterns and function/axial/radial shadings
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Function objects and sh command serialize, and examples use dictionaries. No dedicated shading object checks coordinate shapes, radii, domains or colour/function arity.
remainingWork: Dedicated function/axial/radial shading and shading-pattern objects with semantic checks.

mechanisms.title: Triangle, lattice, Coons and tensor-product mesh streams
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Tables preserve BitsPerCoordinate/Component/Flag/Decode/VerticesPerRow requirements. Vertex/patch bitstream encoding and edge flag relationships are missing.
remainingWork: Typed vertices/patches/flags, MSB-first quantized stream packing and source coordinate/component decode checks with independent meshes.

mechanisms.title: External object resources
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: InvokeXObject operators and resource dictionaries exist; PS XObject legacy semantics are not specialized.
remainingWork: Typed XObject resource contract shared by image/form/PostScript families.

mechanisms.title: Image samples, masks, encoded image streams
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Eight-bit device gray/RGB/CMYK samples, separate eight-bit gray soft mask and explicit DCT are supported; all depths, calibrated/special spaces, image masks and colour-key masks are not specialized.
remainingWork: PDF sample depths 1/2/4/8/16 and packing, decode ranges, stencil masks, colour-key masks, explicit SMaskInData/Matte and generalized colour spaces.

mechanisms.title: Form XObjects, groups and reference XObjects
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Streams can express form dictionaries, but no specialized immutable form stream validates BBox/Matrix/Resources/group and external-reference relationships.
remainingWork: Typed form stream, group and reference XObject compositions with explicit resource inheritance.

mechanisms.title: Optional-content groups and membership policies
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Group, configuration, usage and membership schemas exist; no graph-level validation of ON/OFF, Order/RBGroups or visibility expression structure exists.
remainingWork: Explicit OCG/OCMD objects, Boolean visibility expression tree and configuration identity checks.

mechanisms.title: Text objects, state and glyph positioning
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: All text operators and rendering modes serialize with scope checks. Encoding and font resource identities are caller supplied; text shaping and rendering are consumer/external-font behaviors.
remainingWork: Resource-aware text state validation and typed encoded glyph strings/TJ arrays.

mechanisms.title: Type1, MMType1, TrueType and Type3 font dictionaries
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Type1 standard fonts and Type3 glyph instruction scopes exist. Dedicated simple-font widths/encoding/Differences/Type3 CharProcs graph models are incomplete.
remainingWork: Explicit simple font encoding/width arrays, Type3 glyph dictionary and first/last-char constraints; full Type1/CFF program parsing is external.

mechanisms.title: CIDFontType0/2 and horizontal/vertical Type0 composites
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: CIDFontType2, CIDToGIDMap and widths are bound to one explicit repertoire; Type0 uses Identity-H only. CIDFontType0 and vertical metrics/W2/DW2 are not specialized.
remainingWork: Typed CIDSystemInfo, generalized CMap selection, CIDFontType0 and vertical glyph metrics; identity/reference consistency.

mechanisms.title: Predefined and embedded character-to-CID CMaps
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Identity-H is hardcoded in a specialized Type0 constructor. Arbitrary codespace/cidchar/cidrange/notdef/usecmap programs are not modeled.
remainingWork: Explicit codespaces, code-to-CID mappings/ranges, notdef rules, writing mode and UseCMap dependencies.

mechanisms.title: Font metrics and descriptors
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Explicit TrueType font descriptors and flags are tied to the font name/program; generic schemas cover other families but do not enforce all font-specific constraints.
remainingWork: All descriptor/font-family requirements and CIDSet/FontFamily/Panose semantic objects.

mechanisms.title: FontFile/FontFile2/FontFile3 stream bindings
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: FontFile2 and normalized CID font program bytes are explicit; optional font module interprets external sfnt/glyf. Type1 length segments, CFF/Type1C/CIDFontType0C/OpenType and subset tags are not generalized.
remainingWork: Typed PDF font program stream variants and Length1/2/3 rules, subset prefix semantics; external program encoders remain separate.

mechanisms.title: ToUnicode mappings and text extraction hints
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: ToUnicode emits two-byte codes to single Unicode scalars including surrogate pairs with bfchar chunks. Variable-length source codes, bfrange and multi-scalar targets are missing; extraction itself is a reader behavior.
remainingWork: General ToUnicode codespaces/ranges and Unicode sequences, with the CMap100-entry chunk limits.

mechanisms.title: Colour conversion, transfer, halftones and scan conversion
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Dictionaries can declare halftones/transfer functions. There is no rasterizer or colour-conversion engine in the core; rendering algorithms are not required to serialize a PDF but remain unimplemented consumer behavior.
remainingWork: Typed PDF transfer/halftone graph and explicit spot-function/threshold stream packing; renderer algorithms belong to a dedicated consumer module.

mechanisms.title: Transparency groups, blend modes and soft masks
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Image soft mask construction exists; PDF compositing equations are not evaluated. Group/SMask dictionary conditional constraints, luminosity masks and graphics soft-mask dependencies are schemas only.
remainingWork: Typed transparency group and soft mask objects; blend mode and BC/TR/G relationship checks; compositing renderer remains separate.

mechanisms.title: Viewer preference object values
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Dictionary entry types are checked but all enum/range/conditional preference rules are not specialized.
remainingWork: Typed preference enums/objects and PrintPageRange/NumCopies/PickTrayByPDFSize constraints.

mechanisms.title: Destinations, outlines, article threads and labels
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Explicit destinations, names and outline parent/Prev/Next/Count are implemented. Page label numbering and article bead/thread graphs are schema only.
remainingWork: Page label objects and number tree checks; thread/bead circular list identities; remote/embedded destination invariants.

mechanisms.title: Page presentation transitions and navigation nodes
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Dictionaries serialize values without specialized timing/transition enum/reference-graph checks.
remainingWork: Transition objects, duration limits and presentation navigation graph validation.

mechanisms.title: Annotation identities, flags, bounds and subtypes
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: All subtype dictionaries are named schemas. QuadPoints, vertices, ink lists, line endings, border dash arrays and subtype-specific geometry are not specialized.
remainingWork: Annotation subtype object construction, shared page identity, all geometry/flag/conditional values and Popup/IRT dependencies.

mechanisms.title: Appearance states and appearance stream graphs
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: AP/AS and form XObject definitions can be serialized, but no immutable appearance state dictionary checks annotation state alignment or generates appearances.
remainingWork: Explicit normal/rollover/down appearance objects, state selection and transformed BBox/Rect binding.

mechanisms.title: Action dictionary composition and trigger events
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: All action dictionary entries are modeled, but references, enum/array/conditional operands are not generally checked. Executing JavaScript/URI/Launch actions is a consumer behavior, not writer execution.
remainingWork: Typed action families/flags and ordered Next action graph; explicit trigger event dictionaries; serialization only for executable payloads.

mechanisms.title: AcroForm field tree, hierarchy, names and inheritable entries
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Dictionary schemas exist; explicit canonical Fields tree, fully-qualified-name uniqueness, Parent/Kids/Widgets alignment and inherited FT/Ff/V/DA/Q are missing at the audited release.
remainingWork: Object field tree with cycles/duplicates/ownership checks and explicit inherited field state.

mechanisms.title: Pushbutton, check box and radio button value/appearance state
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Schemas do not maintain V/DV/AS and matching normal appearance states or validate radio group exports.
remainingWork: Button flags and states as objects, Off/export names, radios-in-unison and no-toggle-to-off constraints.

mechanisms.title: Text, list and combo fields with typed values
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: MaxLen, Comb/password/multiline constraints and choice Opt/V/I index relationships are not validated beyond basic entry types.
remainingWork: Text/choice value objects, export/display options, multiselect/sort/edit flag constraints and valid appearance state.

mechanisms.title: Signature fields and seed values
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Signature value and seed-value dictionaries are schemas; signing/seed policy enforcement has no core execution.
remainingWork: Explicit signature field seed constraints and integration with reserved signature placeholders.

mechanisms.title: Submit/reset/import form actions and named-page templates
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Flag and field-reference parameters serialize; form selection semantics, resets and submission encoding are not modeled.
remainingWork: Typed field selection and PDF action flag combinations; form export/import data objects with explicit encodings.

mechanisms.title: Forms Data Format header/body/trailer/catalogue/pages
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Named FDF dictionaries exist; FileWriter emits PDF headers and requires PDF Root/pages. There is no independent FDF file serialization API.
remainingWork: FDF-specific header/trailer/file graph objects and writer, without PDF page requirements.

mechanisms.title: XFA packet streams and PDF association
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: PDF XFA key can be an array or stream; packet naming/order/UTF8 PDF bindings are not specialized. XFA layout/schema processing is an externally referenced standard.
remainingWork: Typed packet stream/packet name association and PDF restrictions; external XFA engine stays optional.

mechanisms.title: ByteRange signature placeholders and signing
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Historical encrypted writer exempts valid signature Contents bytes but never signs. Reserved Contents, final ByteRange patching and CMS/PKCS1 generation are absent.
remainingWork: Typed placeholder capacity/byte ranges, serialization layout capture, external signer contract and deterministic finalization with independent openssl/pdf validation.

mechanisms.title: DocMDP/UR/FieldMDP and signature permissions
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Reference/transform dictionaries are modeled but relationships to revision history, allowed modifications and field locking are not enforced.
remainingWork: Typed transform constraints and signature reference consistency; validation of external signed revisions belongs to reader/signature modules.

mechanisms.title: PKCS1/PKCS7 signature containers and revocation
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: PKCS/CMS/ASN1 codecs, certificate validation and revocation/timestamp services are separate standards. Core presently only permits opaque signature bytes.
remainingWork: Explicit container/hash/certificate objects and injected cryptographic backend; proof of PDF ByteRange/container correspondence.

mechanisms.title: 2D viewports, measure and number format dictionaries
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: 2D measurement unit arrays, coordinate/scale functions and number formatting rules are not executable objects. Supplement3D mapping is a separate validated subset.
remainingWork: Typed viewport measure/number-format arithmetic and geometry, with explicit source units.

mechanisms.title: Requirement handlers and bit flags
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Names and dictionaries exist without complete value and handler reference checks.
remainingWork: Typed requirement names/flags and handler type consistency.

mechanisms.title: Renditions, media clips, play/screen criteria
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: The PDF dictionaries are defined; rendition relationships, duration objects and player/platform requirement constraints are not specialized. Playback is a consumer behavior.
remainingWork: Explicit PDF rendition/clip/criteria object graphs and enum/conditional validation; optional external player integration.

mechanisms.title: Sound/movie streams and alternate presentations
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Sound/movie/presentation schemas exist. Sample packing/declared external media payloads and presentation identity rules are not specialized.
remainingWork: Typed sound sample stream format; movie/poster/reference constraints; alternate presentation graph.

mechanisms.title: 3D streams, views, nodes and activation
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: 3D dictionaries and supplement measurement mapping exist; no U3D/PRC decoder/renderer. PDF view/camera matrices, activation and named node relationships lack dedicated validation.
remainingWork: Typed PDF 3D view/camera/activation/projection and node transformation model; external U3D/PRC engine is optional.

mechanisms.title: ProcSet and XML metadata streams
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Information entries and metadata stream dictionaries can be serialized; XMP/RDF validation and namespace/document info correspondence are not specialized.
remainingWork: Typed metadata stream/document packet bindings; external XMP schema parser remains separate.

mechanisms.title: File ID and page-piece data
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Trailer ID pairs are explicit; incremental permanent IDs are preserved and changing IDs renewed. Page-piece Private data/date relationships remain schemas.
remainingWork: Page-piece application identifier/private data/LastModified object constraints.

mechanisms.title: Marked-content tags, properties and artifacts
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: BMC/BDC/MP/DP/EMC objects and scope checks exist; Bates artifact is explicit. Resource properties/MCID uniqueness/structure parents are not integrated at the audited release.
remainingWork: Explicit general artifact/property objects and connection to tagged-PDF structure identity.

mechanisms.title: Structure hierarchy, content items and parent trees
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: StructTreeRoot/StructElem/MCR/OBJR schemas exist. No managed parent tree, RoleMap/ClassMap or bidirectional MCID/StructParent identity checks are present at the audited release.
remainingWork: Explicit structure tree/root/element/content objects with ParentTree numbers, ownership, role mapping and ID uniqueness.

mechanisms.title: Standard tags, attributes and reading order
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Tag names and attribute tables are inventory entries, not a validated tagged graph. Attribute required/optional values and inheritance metadata need review; negative not-inheritable qualifiers currently have an extraction defect.
remainingWork: Typed standard structure roles/attributes/artifacts and semantic constraints for lists/tables/ruby/warichu/layout; fix not-inheritable metadata; independent tagged graph tests.

mechanisms.title: Natural language, alternate text and replacement text
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Lang/Alt/ActualText/E entries serialize but their scope, inheritance and multi-language array structure are not dedicated objects. There is no PDF/UA conformance claim.
remainingWork: Typed language/alternate/replacement text objects and hierarchy constraints; modern PDF/UA requires a separate standard.

mechanisms.title: Web capture source and content sets
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Tables can describe web-capture objects but URL/source/content-set cyclic reference identities and date/checksum constraints are not specialized.
remainingWork: Typed web-capture identifier/source/content-set graph; web fetching and HTML conversion stay external.

mechanisms.title: Page boxes, printer marks, output intents, trapping and OPI
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Rectangles and all prepress dictionary schemas exist. Output profile bindings, box containment, separations, trap region/appearance and OPI value semantics are not dedicated objects.
remainingWork: Typed page-boundary validation, OutputIntent/ICC profile and OPI source constraints; trapping itself is consumer behavior.

mechanisms.title: Normative complete 73-token operator inventory
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: The complete operator token inventory exists, including obsolete F and BI/ID/EI composed by InlineImage. Tokens do not prove all resource/state semantics.

mechanisms.title: Normative calculator operator grammar
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Calculator instruction/procedure objects serialize the operator vocabulary; stack evaluation is a reader operation.

mechanisms.title: Architectural and memory limits
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Allocation/overflow limits protect selected writers/images/sample grids; all architectural PDF limits are not an explicit reusable constraint policy.
remainingWork: Reusable numeric/name/string/tree/graphics limits and document-level checks appropriate to conforming writers.

mechanisms.title: Latin, PDFDocEncoding, MacExpert, Symbol and ZapfDingbats
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Encoding tables are retained in the source/table inventory, but no explicit byte/code/glyph maps expose every listed encoding as a PDF object model.
remainingWork: Immutable predefined encoding vectors and Differences object composition; PDFDocEncoding encoder/decoder for historical passwords and text strings.

mechanisms.title: PDF name registry and developer prefixes
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Four-byte developer prefixes are validated structurally. The library does not assert registry registration for a caller-selected prefix.

mechanisms.title: Linearized PDF layout and hint tables
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Linearization/hint dictionary tables exist, but FileWriter does not implement first-page layout, two xref sections, L/H/O/E/N/T calculation or packed page/shared-object hints.
remainingWork: Explicit linearization plan and writer, page/object dependency ordering, hint packing and final offsets with qpdf check-linearization validation.

mechanisms.title: Informative example access strategies for linearized PDFs
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: This annex is an informative reader strategy, not a separate file-writing algorithm. The optional reader does not stream partial HTTP byte ranges.
remainingWork: If desired, optional PDF-reader range access with bounded dependencies, separately from core.

mechanisms.title: Informative source examples and reference structures
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Current examples demonstrate minimal documents, text, graphics, page/outline trees and updates. Matching each source example byte-for-byte is not a conformance requirement.

mechanisms.title: Informative Windows launch dictionary example
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Source action/dictionary names are representable. Launch execution belongs to the application/reader, and writer must never execute it.

mechanisms.title: Informative PostScript-to-PDF conversion overview
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: The source explains conversion mappings. No PostScript parser/interpreter is part of core or provided packages.

mechanisms.title: Informative colour plate examples
mechanisms.semanticConstraintCoverage: Visual sample pages illustrate prior mechanisms; preserving the PDF source is complete, but this is not a separately implemented API.

currentDevelopment.readingRule: The historical mechanism/table/algorithm assessments above remain the 0.3.0 baseline. These evidence-backed changes supersede only their stated native behavior. No class count or successful syntax check implies complete clause coverage.

unreleasedChanges.title: Native LZW and TIFF/PNG predictors
implementedBehavior: EarlyChange 0 and 1; MSB-first 9/10/11/12-bit codes; initial clear, full-table clear and end-of-data.
TIFF sample differencing and all five PNG byte-row filters, composed with Flate or LZW.
Explicit fixed and adaptive PNG row selection.
semanticConstraints: Explicit Colors/Columns and BitsPerComponent 1/2/4/8/16; complete padded rows.
Big-endian 16-bit samples, modulo arithmetic, row-state reset, Paeth tie order and byte-width rounding.
Retain unused TIFF low padding bits; reject malformed row lengths and size overflow.

validation.independentResult: 1292 encoded streams; a separate sequence-dictionary LZW inverse and qpdf output agree for both EarlyChange modes. The 100000-byte cases reach every code width and 26 clear codes. Ignored TIFF low padding is compared byte-exactly by the separate inverse; qpdf canonicalizes those unused bits.

remainingWorkOrBoundary: This is an encoder and transform model in core; external PDF stream reading is provided by pdf-reader.

unreleasedChanges.title: Native Annex F file layout and all standard hint-table formats
implementedBehavior: Native ordering/renumbering of initial multi-page graphs, shared resources, catalog/document-open objects and objects outside page closures.
Traditional, binary and hybrid cross references; requested compressed members are rebuilt with remapped numbers.
Arbitrary initial page from OpenAction, including named destinations; inherited page values are copied onto serialized leaves.
Page/shared/generic/extended/thumbnail/embedded-file binary hints, whole-object primary/overflow extents and seamless hint continuation.
Explicit FileEncryption integrates strings, body/hint streams, metadata selection and clear xref containers.
Explicit ThumbnailGraphNormalization creates exclusive output-only copies for reused image roots and dependencies also needed by page/document graphs.
Shared EmbeddedFile groups use zero private count and length with complete shared hint references, as required by F.4.6.
semanticConstraints: Input identities, explicit identifiers and file graph remain unchanged; all layout changes occur in the output plan.
Page Kids/Parent/Count, acyclic ownership, effective resources/media box and OpenAction destination ownership are validated.
Every page and thumbnail range begins at its root; numbered groups and physical ranges remain consecutive.
Shared thumbnail dependencies are exclusive to thumbnails after normalization. Original identities remain represented once in their external use.
Embedded-file groups never mix private objects with shared references.
Containing object identifiers govern encrypted strings/streams; copied image Metadata is encrypted even when the actual document Metadata is exempt.
Explicit maximum object/file/hint uint32 capacities and generation-zero initial graph.

validation.independentResult: 183 initial-page/xref/compression/primary/overflow/R2-R5 variants plus 96 normalized thumbnail and private/shared-only EmbeddedFile graphs. Independent strict pypdf xrefs and an ISO-based bit/range oracle check the actual bytes; qpdf checks supported linearization classifications.
validatorLimits: qpdf 12.4.2 reads P but validates against logical page 0. P=2 has independent source-based range and hint validation, not a claimed successful qpdf linearization check.

qpdf does not read Tables F.11/F.12 and compares its own page-only shared classification. Shared-EF hint correctness is checked independently; qpdf strictly reads and rewrites these PDFs, then checks the rebuilt file.

pypdf does not implement Crypt Identity selection for an exempt document Metadata stream. Its actual original byte span and Identity declaration are checked directly; copied thumbnail Metadata is independently decrypted.

remainingWorkOrBoundary: LinearizedWriter currently writes the initial bytes; it does not return a FileRevision snapshot for subsequent IncrementalWriter updates. Appending an update invalidates linearization as defined by F.1.
Native repacking currently creates one logical member per generated ObjStm container. The input filter chain is retained; container bytes/numbers change.
The writer does not sign a live Contents reservation; signing/finalization uses the explicit signature writer pipeline.
No claim that arbitrary raw dictionaries/content, consumer scheduling, or every external codec is fully conforming.

unreleasedChanges.title: Native hybrid-reference initial and incremental layouts

clauses.title: Compatibility with Applications That Do Not Support Compressed Reference Streams

implementedBehavior: Classic compatibility preamble plus a subsequent classic update carrying XRefStm and Prev; the auxiliary stream records compressed members.
Source object-stream containers are normalized to expand required catalog/page/font/resource dependencies with the same logical numbers.
Optional hidden compressed identifiers are free at generation 65535 in the compatibility table.
Incremental body/xrefs preserve the previous byte prefix; an old compressed value becoming required is written as its effective frozen value, under the existing logical identifier.
Annex F hybrid layout expands its complete first section and records hidden main-section members through an auxiliary stream.
semanticConstraints: Visible dependencies are conservative: required references, unknown conditional references, direct arrays, pages/resources/fonts/FontDescriptor/Widths stay available to a classic reader.
XRefStm refers to the auxiliary stream, Prev follows classic sections and auxiliary streams are not encrypted.
Header and Catalog.Version form the effective PDF version; hybrid and object-stream capabilities require PDF 1.5.
Revision aliases, serialized container identities and object byte spans match the emitted layout.

validation.independentResult: Six initial/incremental/replacement/newly-visible/linearized/overflow files. Unmodified pypdf and qpdf verify the modern graph; qpdf --ignore-xref-streams --suppress-recovery reads the classic visible graph, rewrites it, and checks the rebuilt file. Font descriptor, width array, page/resource/catalog dependencies remain visible. Annex F variants also belong to the 183-file linearization corpus.

remainingWorkOrBoundary: This verifies hybrid mechanics and declared classic graph visibility; it does not certify that arbitrary PDF 1.7 features execute in a historical PDF 1.4 application.
The optional pdf-reader package still rejects XRefStm; its hybrid reader support is separate work and release.
General object freeing/reuse and historical generation advancement are still open.

unreleasedChanges.title: Historical ISO password handlers, explicit crypt selection and encrypted revisions
implementedBehavior: ISO algorithms 1-7 for R=2/3/4: password entries, file-key derivation, authentication and RC4/AESV2 data encryption.
Explicit StrF/StmF/EFF, named filters, Identity and document metadata exemption.
Encrypted incremental revisions retain their encryption dictionary/file key and original byte ranges.
Historical Adobe R=5 remains explicitly available; it is a separate inherited supplement mechanism.
semanticConstraints: PDFDocEncoding password bytes and length/key/permission bounds are explicit.
ISO 7.4.10 and Algorithm 1: streams with an explicit Crypt specifier use the selected key as-is; implicit legacy streams derive the object key.
Only effective document Metadata is exempt when EncryptMetadata=false; page/other Metadata and ordinary strings remain encrypted.
Encrypt identity replacement, compressed members aliasing that identifier, incompatible file IDs and plaintext trailer strings are rejected.
R=2 requires PDF 1.1; feature availability follows effective header/catalog version.

validation.independentResult: 68 PDFs: 34 initial and 34 incremental, historical key-length boundaries, RC4/AESV2, explicit/default/Identity/EFF selectors and metadata. Independent source-correct named-stream key checks and unmodified pyHanko native filtering are distinguished from unsupported reader cases.

remainingWorkOrBoundary: Historical mechanisms are exposed explicitly; modern R=6 is outside these two retained documents.

qpdf legacy named-Crypt decryption applies a per-object key in cases where the retained ISO requires the explicit key as-is; that interop limitation is recorded and never converted into a false source-conformance claim.
External PDF reading, credential UI and a security-default policy belong to consumers/other packages.

unreleasedChanges.title: CMS recipient encryption with explicit source interpretations
implementedBehavior: s3/s4/s5 recipient envelopes, RC4/AESV2/AESV3 content, independent filter seeds/keys and recipient sets.
Initial/incremental writing for traditional, stream and hybrid xrefs; attachment-only/default/named selections.
Explicit permission byte-order interpretation distinguishes retained ISO 2008 wording from later corrected interoperability.
semanticConstraints: DER/CMS recipient data, seed length, permission values, default filter names, CF selections and containing object keys are checked.

implementedBehavior: Reserve fixed Contents and ByteRange, freeze exact byte spans before signing and fill the reservation without shifting any bytes.

semanticConstraints: Contents is excluded from the actual signed ranges and signature bytes are not encrypted as ordinary string data.

A completed DER/CMS container, public-key verification and digest checks prove actual emitted cryptographic integrity; declared policy facts alone do not.
Required unimplemented seed/lock orchestration causes rejection rather than silently ignoring the requirement.

validation.independentResult: 108 PDFs and 162 signed byte ranges: 6 security cases × 3 xref layouts × 3 ISO formats × initial/incremental. qpdf checks the plaintext semantic view; ASN.1/PyCA verify the original encrypted or clear byte ranges, actual digests, PKCS#1/CMS values, incremental preservation and tamper failure. CMS backends use their declared SHA256 digest by default; adbe.pkcs7.sha1 still encapsulates the required SHA1 digest of PDF ranges and RSA_SHA1 is tested separately.

remainingWorkOrBoundary: Certificate trust, revocation, timestamp authority and key custody remain explicit external policies.
